answers.how: Fitting the cup's vertical positions gives about 2810 px/s², so the scale is 9.8/2810 m/px. Its roughly 70 px height converts to 0.245 m.
A quadratic fit to the cup's positions gives about 728 px/s at 0.25 s; converting with the acceleration-derived scale gives 2.54 m/s.
The fitted velocity at 0.5 s is about 1430 px/s; converting with the acceleration-derived scale gives 4.99 m/s.
The fitted velocity at 0.625 s is about 1781 px/s; converting with the acceleration-derived scale gives 6.21 m/s.
